source.title: Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1952, p. 1 ("County and Rural Council Elections: No Contests in County and Armagh Rural")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text of the page, which is clean (not compared line by line with the image); returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1952: nominations 20 May 1952; every seat returned unopposed. The list prints no party labels (so none are given) and has no entry for Crossmore. Returned unopposed. Isaac G. Hawthorne: no party label printed in 1952. At other elections he stood as Unionist (South Armagh, Parliament of Northern Ireland, 10 February 1949, listed as Unionist; Central Armagh, Parliament of Northern Ireland, 15 October 1955, listed as Unionist).
